ios.desc:
Contact Lens Tracker & Lens Reminder app designed for easy contact lenses management and eye health tracking. Never miss a replacement with smart lens reminder alerts for daily, weekly, and monthly contact lens schedules.

LensesBuddy: Contact Lenses is a powerful contact lens tracker that helps you monitor each contact lens use, track replacement cycles, and maintain consistent hygiene. Whether you use soft contact lenses, daily disposables, or monthly lenses, the app adapts to your routine with precise lens tracking.

Set personalized lens reminder notifications so you never forget when to replace your contact lenses. Track usage history for each eye, manage multiple contact lenses types, and stay organized with a clean, intuitive lens tracker interface.

Key features:

Contact lens tracker for all lens types
Smart lens reminder and contact lens reminder notifications
Full contact lenses usage history tracking
Daily, weekly, and monthly replacement schedules
Eye health and hygiene support reminders
Easy tracking for multiple contact lens prescriptions

LensesBuddy: Contact Lenses helps you build better habits, reduce eye irritation risk, and maintain healthy vision through consistent contact lens tracking and timely lens reminders.

Join users who rely on LensesBuddy: Contact Lenses as their daily contact lens tracker and lens reminder solution.

Subscription Required: Full access to all tools and features requires an active subscription. Choose between monthly or annual plans after download.
